proposal.summary: An improper certificate validation vulnerability (CWE-295) in multiple Fortinet products may allow a network-adjacent, unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle communications between the listed products and some external peers.
proposal.affected_product: FortiManager 7.0.1 and below, 6.4.6 and below; FortiAnalyzer 7.0.2 and below, 6.4.7 and below; FortiOS 6.2.x and 6.0.x; FortiSandbox 4.0.x, 3.2.x and 3.1.x

C.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

I.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the MITM by testing certificate validation between affected versions and representative external peers (capture TLS handshakes and certificate verification behavior). Collect packet traces and server/client logs, identify vulnerable components and configurations, and request or confirm vendor fixes/patches.
